title: Swell v2 (expression)
comment: A CC11 expression demo, 16 bars at 66 BPM, D major turning to B minor. Bars 1-4 shape single notes (cello swells and tapers, pad hairpins), bars 5-8 crescendo strings and horns into a timpani roll, bars 9-12 fall away from a forte arrival on G, bars 13-16 fade a held D chord to silence. This is the shaped version, with CC11 on cello, strings, horns, and timpani.
